supplementalViews.title: Northern CHSA disease incidence
supplementalViews.sourceName: BC Ministry of Health via BCCDC / PHSA Community Health Data
supplementalViews.timeLabel: FY 2001–2002 through FY 2020–2021 · CHSA v2018 · retrieved 12 October 2026
notes: Supplementary public measurements retrieved directly from BCCDC/PHSA on 12 October 2026. They were not present as CHSA scientific rows in the collected Zoer C016 CSV; C016 only supplies related inventory context.

Native CHSA identifiers, names and hierarchy match the source profile’s 2018 boundary configuration. The map uses the archived Ministry geometry mirrored by Community Map of Canada, not PGMaps current 2022 polygons. McBride/Valemount remains one 2018 area; its value is not split between later McBride and Valemount areas.

The two views retain eight original indicators, Total only, over FY 2001.2002 through FY 2020.2021. A normalized display period retains the fiscal duration. October 2026 retrieval does not make these rates current.

Rates use the 2011 Canadian Census population for age standardization. They are published administrative-registry measures per 1,000, not raw cases or crude percentages. Incidence and lifetime prevalence have separate definitions, retained with the original notes and further-information link.

Asthma and diabetes use ages 1+, COPD ages 35+, and hypertension ages 20+. Different age universes limit cross-condition rankings. Select one indicator and fiscal period for one value per CHSA; rates are not additive across places or conditions.

The database download omits 187 potential indicator/year cells among the 29 listed Northern CHSAs. Six latest missing cells have explicit profile CSV dashes and remain null; other absent historical cells remain absent. The dash does not specify its particular non-release reason. Neither omissions nor unreleased communities are assigned zero.

Forty Northern v2018 context polygons include 29 publicly listed measured CHSAs. The portal excludes publicly identifiable Indigenous CHSAs; no restricted values are requested or reconstructed. This public subset cannot supply a complete Northern total.

The source warns that small numerator or denominator counts can create volatility and obscure trends. Confidence intervals are not provided in these downloads. Rates do not establish trial eligibility, service demand, causal changes or NHHR effects, and are not multiplied by population projections to infer cases.

Database rates retain their reported one-decimal precision. The 226 reported latest cells reconcile with the higher-precision profile literals within the source rounding interval; those profile literals are verification evidence rather than replacement series values.

boundaryProposals.title: Archived cancer incidence

boundaryProposals.title: Combined North Coast and Nechako labour estimates
boundaryProposals.recommended: Connected: verified union of PGMaps 2021 economic regions 5960 and 5970.

boundaryProposals.title: Finer community health maps
boundaryProposals.recommended: Connected: supplementary PHSA incidence and lifetime-prevalence rates for 29 publicly listed Northern CHSAs, joined by native codes to matching 2018 display boundaries.

Forty archived Ministry polygons from the Community Map of Canada mirror provide display context; current PGMaps polygons cannot replace the changed 2018 McBride/Valemount geography. Historical omitted cells and unreleased communities remain missing, and the mirror is used for visualization only.

boundaryProposals.reason: The official university address agrees with independently retrieved OpenStreetMap campus geometry. Institution-wide totals are not allocated to a campus, individual project or nearby population.

McBride/Valemount remains one historical area. No health-authority values are allocated downward.
